cases.goal: Reconstruct held-out inputs through a learned particle AE and four public DDGAN reverse steps while preserving independent generation and conditional-transition quality
cases.sampling: Public DDGAN [1,.9,.5,.05,.0001]; N(0,I) terminal start; fresh independent learned-MoG latent/kernel noise and Gaussian reverse noise at EVERY step; eight heldout time/observation transition panels; separate paired cohort: encode held-out clean input once, hold its deterministic AE code through all four reverse steps from independent N(0,I), fresh Gaussian reverse noise each step; shuffled-code control shares identical start and reverse noise

cases.goal: Can a genuine particle VAE retain the input and posterior noise while independently generating both target modes?
cases.initialization: particlegan.init.deterministic_orthogonal_: E seed0, G seed1, D seed2, prior R2 seed3; isolated constructor scope seed0
cases.sampling: Independent uniform learned MoG prior with fixed latent sigma=.025; live decoder means and separate Gaussian likelihood draws G(z)+.03*epsilon. Reconstructions use eight posterior draws with prior-matching local Gaussian noise.
cases.scope: New constrained two-mode seed-0 public-component cohort; does not reproduce or qualify historical 100-mode results. Hard routing has constant log(K) KL and biased straight-through gradients; categorical routing uses the public leave-one-out score estimator and a variable KL. A stochastic no-KL AE is not a VAE.
cases.title: Categorical particle VAE: two noisy anchors
